classification: Local author mathematical and implementation review; not independent review
scope: NS91 identities, complete grouped tail, finite certificates, and quadratic-rewrite audit; no cofinal gain
checked: Integration by parts keeps both endpoints and the complete Q potential.
Bounded J combines the terms before absolute values; no separately divergent terms are estimated.
Endpoint correction belongs to the old space and preserves numerator and true projected cost.
D=st through N follows from the exact NS90 divisor identities; subtracting Ns a_N removes the whole initial interval.
The code uses an exact zero-weighted-sum coefficient rule, not midpoint rounding.
The dyadic partition is fixed independently of signs.
The outer bound controls sum of absolute dyadic integrals, not merely absolute signed tail.
Bernoulli primitive is continuous at integer knots; its derivative identity holds almost everywhere.
Shared dyadic endpoints carry coefficient two; all residual and potential remainder terms are retained.
Exact Gamma/digamma endpoint formula is derived directly from complete cells.
Prior Gram numerator is used for validation only, after computing the new lower bound.
Coarse finite percentages are not extrapolated; a fixed positive contraction would contradict NS83.
The N^6 absolute grouped-tail estimate uses NS81/NS83 asymptotically and has no effective onset.
No uniform canonical norm or RH-strength raw-cost bound is assumed.
NS78 inversion is prior work; the quadratic rewrite is not filed as a new positivity mechanism.
The constrained residual space has dimension one, including beta=0 giving the zero residual.
The sufficient margin/cost ratio is left open; neither uniform margin nor uniform projected cost is assumed.
development_corrections: An initial exploratory endpoint-Q enclosure amplified loose tail radii through the interval sum; replaced by the exact complete Gamma/digamma expression before certification.

publication: Integrated in claimed NS91 branch; manuscript v1.66 unchanged
what_had_to_change: Combine the signed forcing before absolute values; remove Ns a_N in the old space; count both shared dyadic boundaries in the full tail.
obstruction: No independent uniform bound on the finite grouped arithmetic margin relative to its actual projected cost.
bound_or_object: NS90 bound repaired at tested finite sizes; no eventual failure or success of the direction is proved.
